Incredible how fast the goalposts moved from "any PR is an existential threat to my time" to "let's audition alternative tech celebrities." People don't care about min-maxing quote clout; they just don't want quotes from a white supremacist on the project's homepage. Pick literally any boring quote from someone who doesn't publish xenophobic manifestos and hit merge, make your Thursday a lot easier.

Drew used Neovim until vim-classic, since AI is also "fashware". Even if he isn't a user, he may still have an excellent opinion of Neovim which we can proudly display, thus assuring the world of our allegiance to all of his beliefs.

But any famous person will do, e.g. Hunter Biden, anyone that isn't cancelled

Who *is* "cancelled"? DHH? The dude worth hundreds of millions of dollars, sitting on the board of Shopify, a publicly-traded company his billionaire best-bud runs? The dude set to give the opening keynote at RailsWorld next month? The dude whose Linux "distro" side-project just received $10M in funding? Get a grip.
